title: Construct tools round 2: 12 new designs
desc: Twelve new hard-light tool designs (twin sabres, khopesh, glaive, labrys, scythe, halberd, greatsword, chakram, trident and more) in Green and Blue; J: "I need at least several new design options ... like double swords but large and curved like the axe there".

takes.name: D1 Twin moon sabres (green)
takes.facts: Green "Jade relic" (as T1); half-pixel voxels, construct texture on the broad faces, layered rim + inlay; pair, crossed; orthographic, all designs at one scale (true relative sizes)
